mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 39 degrees, though it feels like 33.

In city news, please remember that winter parking regulations are in effect from November 20 through April 1, requiring you to park on alternating sides of the street overnight. Also, the Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.

There is plenty to do, including the Main Street Trick-Or-Treat happening today at Hometown Junction Park. Tomorrow, head downtown for the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol, or check out live music at Paddy Mac's.
Regarding local safety, on October 25, officers located a driver who was arrested for O W I, which stands for operating while intoxicated, after he was found unresponsive in his vehicle.
Today's flavor is the delicious Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and grab a scoop.
